architectural_decisions.rationale: The architecture implemented for the development of the Revivack project system is a microservices-based architecture.
Traefik acts as a reverse proxy and load balancer, improving the availability and responsiveness of the application.
HTTPS encrypts the data transmitted between the clients and the server, protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the information.

Next.js is a framework for building web applications that supports both client-side and server-side rendering, offering additional structure, features, and optimizations that allow building applications faster and without the need to configure tools manually.
React is an open-source JavaScript library designed to build user interfaces efficiently and flexibly.
Prisma is an ORM tool used to simplify database access and management.
This approach promotes modularity, code reuse, and maintainability, facilitating the management of the application.

The Singleton pattern ensures that a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to that instance, used to manage shared resources where having multiple instances could lead to inconsistent states or inefficient use of resources.
